cohort: Women with preeclampsia and severe preeclampsia
finding: Severe preeclampsia is associated with higher rates of maternal complications such as eclampsia, HELLP syndrome, and pulmonary edema compared to preeclampsia alone.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were higher in women with severe preeclampsia compared to those with preeclampsia (77% vs. 55.5%), although this difference was not statistically significant (P = 0.508).
